value.body: A three-year postgraduate surgical degree covering pregnancy and childbirth, women's reproductive health, infertility and gynaecological surgery. Residents manage labour rooms, antenatal and gynaecology clinics, operations including caesarean sections, and complete a thesis.

items.label: Entrance
items.note: Conducted by NBEMS; counselling by MCC and state authorities

items.label: Regulator
items.note: DNB OBG (NBEMS) is a parallel route

value.title: How you get in
value.body: An MBBS with internship completed and medical registration, then a NEET-PG rank. Seats are allotted through all-India and state counselling; DNB seats in accredited hospitals are filled through the same exam.

value.title: At a glance
items: The work is both medical and surgical, with frequent emergencies and night calls.
Obstetric care carries a notable medico-legal load, so documentation and consent matter a lot.
It leads to consultant and hospital posts, private practice, or further training in areas such as reproductive medicine and gynaecological oncology.
